prompt: In concierge-agent/, the response_quality metric should tolerate one of the dataset's four cases scoring below its threshold of 4, but no more. Then run the evaluation and report the result.

checks.why: one of four below threshold is a pass rate of 0.75

checks.expr: len(data.get('cases', [])) == 4 and all(get(c, 'judge.response_quality.threshold') == 4 for c in data.get('cases', []))
checks.why: a quality rate counts only the cases that declare the metric: scored on 2 cases, one failure is 50 percent

checks.expr: {'greeting', 'weather', 'capabilities', 'weather-follow-up'} <= {c.get('id') for c in data.get('cases', [])} and any(tc.get('name') == 'get_weather' for c in data.get('cases', []) if c.get('id') == 'weather' for tc in (get(c, 'expect.tool_calls') or []))

reference: The scaffolded dataset declares response_quality on greeting and capabilities only, and a quality rate counts only the cases scored on the metric. Declare `"judge": {"response_quality": {"threshold": 4}}` on weather and weather-follow-up too, set `response_quality: { threshold: 4, min_pass_rate: 0.75 }`, run `graph-agents-cli eval run` (exit 0 on the fake judge: plumbing only).
